about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (Isaiah 54:1–55:5) speaks to a barren and forsaken Zion. God compares his oath to Israel with “the waters of Noah”: as he swore never again to flood the earth, he swears that his steadfast love will not depart from her. The reading from the Apostles (2 Peter 3:1–14) looks back to the world that perished in the flood and forward to the day of the Lord. It calls us to holy living while we wait for the renewal of all creation.
